summary: Cartesian Growth Corp II (a blank-check company) issued an unsecured promissory note for $250,000 to its sponsor, CGC II Sponsor LLC. The note bears no interest and is payable upon the earlier of an initial business combination or winding up. The sponsor may convert principal into working capital warrants on identical terms to its IPO private placement warrants. The filing is a routine working capital facility for a SPAC, not a special situation event.
